questions.question: How is a product detector used?

choices.A: Used in test gear to detect spurious mixing products
choices.B: Used in a transmitter to perform frequency multiplication

questions.question: Which of the following is an advantage of a digital signal processing (DSP) filter compared to an analog filter?

choices.A: A wide range of filter bandwidths and shapes can be created
